name: ARA4105
title: Contrast cannot be measured
summary: Text sits over imagery or a transparent surface, so no single contrast ratio is defensible.
html:
Text sits over imagery or a transparent surface, so no single contrast ratio is defensible.

#Common causes

  • Labels drawn directly over a game frame or thumbnail.

#Fixes

  • Put a solid scrim behind the text, or inspect representative imagery.

  • Code: ARA4105

  • Constant: ui::CONTRAST_UNCERTAIN

  • Reported by: ara-ui-test
